a1.text: Return the thing, pay the amount, keep the promise. Civilization has many very short job descriptions.

a2.speaker: npc
a2.text: Clear prices, a place for change, an understandable arrangement. Trust can have good design.

b.speaker: npc
b.text: They could. I don't want to be naive about that. What would you protect first?

b1.speaker: npc
b1.text: A proportionate response. Keep room for the many people who were quietly doing the right thing.

b2.speaker: npc
b2.text: Yes. Losing a few oranges hurts; deciding nobody can be trusted can cost much more.

leave.speaker: npc
leave.text: May your next small agreement work exactly as promised.

ambient_100_the_email_with_five_favors.title: The email with five favors
ambient_100_the_email_with_five_favors.npc_voice: A friendly editor of an overambitious message

start.speaker: npc
start.text: I've written an email asking for advice, an introduction, feedback, a meeting, and perhaps a small miracle. Want to help me improve its odds of a reply?

choices.text: Choose the one thing you need most.
Perhaps some of those questions can wait.

a.speaker: npc
a.text: The introduction, probably. How should I ask?

choices.text: Say why, and make the request specific.
Give them an easy way to say no.

a1.speaker: npc
a1.text: A recipient who understands the task can actually decide. I should stop making them excavate it.

a2.speaker: npc
a2.text: Yes. A clear request doesn't need to become an obligation smuggled inside friendliness.

b.speaker: npc
b.text: Definitely. I had mistaken my entire week for a reasonable thing to place in somebody's inbox. What should stay?

choices.text: Enough context to understand the request.
An honest thank-you and one clear next step.

b1.speaker: npc
b1.text: Just enough to orient them. The memoir can remain a separate literary project.

b2.speaker: npc
b2.text: Human, brief, actionable. It almost sounds like something I'd enjoy receiving myself.

leave.speaker: npc
leave.text: Thank you. One favor asked, one conversation enjoyed. A much better ratio.

adventure-sites.drawFitness.description-.template: An open-air gym with well-used benches, neatly racked weights, and excellent ventilation.

adventure-sites.drawTrainingSites.descri.template: A capital firm with immaculate landscaping and some unusually heavy office furniture.

adventure-sites.createHighwaySites.descr.template: A double-double beacon beyond the Bay Bridge. The palm trees have excellent taste in roadside stops.
The pump accepts every coin you have. The attendant calls this “market pricing.”
A red Ferrari waits beyond the Bay Bridge. Borrow it for free, drive at twenty times walking speed, and refuel here for free.
Free fuel beside the Tahoe gondola. Fill the tank before driving back to San Francisco.

alien-sites.drawIndustrialCenter.descrip.template: A brick-and-sawtooth workshop filled with precision tools and the sound of careful metalwork.

alien-sites.draw.description-4.template: Copper observatories, watchful stained glass, and an armillary instrument of uncertain purpose. A tiny Berkeley campus surrounds the institute: redwoods, a campanile, a colonnaded library, and scholars with impeccable credentials in impossible coincidences. Professor Vale can certify alien evidence.

alien-sites.createEsotericCampus.descrip.template: She has impeccable credentials in a field whose existence is fiercely disputed.

armory.drawArmory.description-2.template: Strangely, this is not where you buy armor.

bunny.createPaintedBunny.description-2.template: A very soft Alamo Square resident. Its entire calendar is reserved for snacks and head pats.

config.item-stats.module.description-2.template: A crinkling silver suit, folded with restaurant precision.

config.item-stats.module.description-4.template: An electromagnetic accelerator. Railgun fire rate increases by 10% while owned.

config.item-stats.module.description-6.template: Tall black leather boots with chrome buckles, steel toe caps, and heavy soles. Block 2 damage from each incoming combat hit.

config.item-stats.module.description-8.template: A sculptural white sphere with red upholstery and a chrome pedestal. Sit (chair) to settle inside.

config.item-stats.module.description-15.template: An oversized decorative rocket. Light it for ten seconds, once a minute. Press Space while it burns to hop about a character-height into the air.

config.item-stats.module.description-17.template: A tiny clock on a chain. It keeps its own appointments.

config.item-stats.module.description-19.template: A sturdy hiking pack with room for twenty sandwiches.

config.item-stats.module.description-21.template: A heavy, shaggy hide. Yohji could make something remarkable from this.

config.item-stats.module.description-23.template: An oversized black top with dropped shoulders, generous sleeves and a long, loose hem.

config.item-stats.module.description-25.template: A sweeping black skirt. Enough fabric to consider the wind a collaborator.

config.item-stats.module.description-27.template: A small purple tablet. Break it to return to downtown San Francisco.

config.item-stats.module.description-29.template: A snowy sigil in purple stone. Break it to appear beside the Tahoe gondola.

config.item-stats.module.description-31.template: A crystalline cuirass. While equipped, blocks 2 damage from each incoming combat hit.

config.item-stats.module.description-33.template: Frosted greaves. While equipped, block 2 damage from each incoming combat hit.

config.item-stats.module.description-35.template: A sandwich. Store it in your food bag and eat it to recover hitpoints.

config.item-stats.module.description-37.template: A tiny vial with a very large social network. Ray accepts these at the Freemasons’ Guild.

config.item-stats.module.description-39.template: Loose coins, awaiting a less theoretical owner.

config.item-stats.module.description-41.template: A very official-looking card. The fine print seems to be turning to dust.

config.item-stats.module.description-43.template: A sand-dusted cowboy hat. The shark was keeping it under its hat.

config.item-stats.module.description-45.template: A salt-stained tricorn. The previous owner had an unusually flexible interpretation of navigation.

config.item-stats.module.description-47.template: The emergency recovery protocol is now considerably less mobile.

config.item-stats.module.description-49.template: The spoils of an extremely unwise maritime expedition.

config.monster-drops.module.description-.template: A Mount Tam goblin in heavy boots. The morning fog followed him down from the mountain.
A coastal campaigner surrounded by an agitated chorus of radios.
A Mount Tam resident who took a wrong turn at the redwoods. He blames the trail signs.
Mount Tam’s most temperamental modernist. His ball chairs are round; his customer service is pointed.
A waterfront regular with strong opinions about unattended sandwiches.
An enormous, shaggy park resident. The haircut is self-maintained.
An abandoned building, a red eye, and a very persistent tenant.
A woodland entrepreneur whose entire business model is your pockets.
He followed the treasure map exactly. Unfortunately, it was a restaurant menu.

cupertino-gardens.drawCupertinoGardens.d.template: A neighbor taking the long way home, with a carefully maintained garden and no particular sense of urgency.
Orchard paths, shaded benches and flowering gardens make a quiet circuit around the ring campus. Short courts lead home to low roofs and gardens.

dog-pony-show.createDogPonyAdministrator.template: A very small impresario with a clipboard, two exceptionally flexible employees, and complete confidence in the programme.

dog-pony-show.drawDogPonyShowground.desc.template: A striped little showground beside Foundry Lane. The dog and pony have rehearsed exactly one trick, and are extremely proud of it.

dog-surfing.dogSurfingDialogue.intro-2.y.template: The judges raise their cards! {v0}. {v1} wins this heat!

dog-surfing.dogSurfingDialogue.intro-2.n.template: Welcome to the Pacifica Dog Surfing Competition! Biscuit, Nori, and Captain Pickles are heading into the next set.

dog-surfing.dogSurfingDialogue.label-5.template: What are the judges looking for?

dog-surfing.dogSurfingDialogue.receipt-6.template: Balance, style, and commitment. Shaking seawater over the judging panel is a deduction. Looking pleased with yourself is encouraged.

dog-surfing.dogSurfingDialogue.receipt-9.template: Biscuit has experience. Nori has balance. Captain Pickles has a tiny life jacket and absolutely no sense of personal risk.

encounter-buildings.drawAbandonedFactory.template: The windows are boarded up. Something inside is still on the clock.

gpu-factory.oceanBeachSandSite.descripti.template: A pile of pale beach sand, with shovels and empty sacks beside it.

gpu-factory.drawGPUFactory.description-4.template: A South Bay chip factory with north-light roof bays, clean-room windows, cooling pipes, and a surprisingly enthusiastic raw-materials department.

guild.module.description-3.template: A sandstone lodge with a checkerboard floor, brass compasses and an unusually well-funded refreshments committee. Ray, in the red suit, handles admission.

guild.module.description-6.template: Heirloom produce, black coats and exceptionally small sunglasses. The farmers grow the future, mostly in vials.

guild.guildDialogue.intro-8.yes.template: Welcome back. The lodge, the library, and the geometrically arranged biscuits are yours.

guild.guildDialogue.intro-8.no.template: Ray, admissions. We like to get to know our applicants. You are currently Rank {v0}, with {v1} peptides carried.

haberdasher-shop.drawHaberdasherShop.des.template: A little hat shop just north of the GPU Factory, with recessed hat displays, a striped canopy, and a projecting top-hat sign.

interaction-targets.tigerInteractionTarg.template: A magnificent striped cat. Currently reviewing your position on the food chain.
An excellent tiger. It has never read a single warning sign.

interaction-targets.ropeInteractionTarge.template: A rope hanging from the airship basket. Climb aboard.

interaction-targets.whaleInteractionTarg.template: A humpback surfaces in the Pacific, followed by a silver plume of spray. Windsurf into position and jump over its back.

jurassic.createExpeditions.description-2.template: A feathered liability with excellent acceleration and no respect for informed consent.

jurassic.createExpeditions.description-5.template: A many-armed calamity. Below half health it becomes enraged: faster tentacles, heavier blows, and very little respect for uninsured ships.

jurassic.drop.description-7.yes.template: The emergency recovery protocol is now considerably less mobile.

jurassic.drop.description-7.no.yes.template: A sandwich. Store it in your food bag and eat it to recover hitpoints.

jurassic.drop.description-7.no.no.no.template: Loose coins, awaiting a less theoretical owner.

jurassic.entries.description-8.yes.template: You have not begun this adventure.

jurassic.entries.description-8.no.yes.template: The scientist issued you a railgun. The velociraptor has escaped.

jurassic.entries.description-8.no.no.no.template: The raptor escape and emergency recovery protocol has been tested. You keep the railgun.

jurassic.entries.description-9.no.template: You have joined Captain Ahab’s hunt.

jurassic.scientistDialogue.intro-12.template: Jurassic Biosciences. We make yesterday’s problems tomorrow’s growth market.

jurassic.scientistDialogue.choice-14.template: Do you have a quest for me?

jurassic.scientistDialogue.intro-17.template: Excellent! Our field test appears to have concluded.

jurassic.scientistDialogue.question-18.template: Why did you release the raptor?

jurassic.scientistDialogue.choice-19.template: Hand over the remains and demand an explanation

jurassic.scientistDialogue.intro-22.template: This was a good test of the raptor escape and emergency recovery protocol.

jurassic.scientistDialogue.receipt-25.template: Certainly. We have classified it as a customer-success expense.

jurassic.scientistDialogue.intro-27.template: The emergency is proceeding within our confidence interval. The velociraptor is somewhere outside the cage.

jurassic.scientistDialogue.question-28.template: What am I supposed to do?

jurassic.scientistDialogue.receipt-30.template: Recover the specimen, please. The paperwork becomes rather difficult when a specimen is also a pedestrian.

jurassic.ahabDialogue.intro-32.yes.template: A fine hunt. Fine shooting! Collect the spoils from the deck. The cape is, regrettably, mandatory.

jurassic.ahabDialogue.intro-32.no.template: There she is! Rather more arms than I remember from the prospectus.

jurassic.ahabDialogue.intro-38.template: A fine hunt! You have already claimed the kraken’s spoils. I am still writing the incident report.

jurassic.ahabDialogue.choice-39.template: How did the cape turn out?

jurassic.ahabDialogue.receipt-40.template: A triumph of maritime understatement. Wear it proudly.

jurassic.ahabDialogue.intro-42.template: I refuse to board a hunter without a sufficiently powerful weapon. Come back with a railgun.

jurassic.ahabDialogue.receipt-45.template: A proper weapon is a matter of judgment. I have strong opinions on both words.

jurassic.ahabDialogue.intro-47.template: A railgun! Now there is a weapon fit for the Pequod.

jurassic.ahabDialogue.intro-54.template: Too hard. We’ll just hunt the kraken instead.

jurassic.ahabDialogue.question-55.template: Board the Pequod for the kraken hunt?

life.draw.description-4.template: A very good dog taking a human out for some much-needed exercise.

neighborhood-interactions.makeNeighborho.template: A cedar bench, made for sitting a while. A very modest antidote to being in a hurry.

nightlife.buildNightlife.description-4.template: A little nightclub in the South Mission, two blocks north of its former home. Mirror ball, colored dance floor, and two regulars with very firm relationship boundaries.

peninsula-details.drawPeninsulaDetails.d.template: Pacifica Commons: a neighborhood green with a fountain, shaded benches, and paths for a very unhurried lap. The ocean air is complimentary.

prometheus.drawPrometheus.description-2.template: Prometheus lifts an eternal flame over the bay. The fire is for everyone; the birds have interpreted this as including the pedestal.

quests.monkeyQuestDialogue.intro-6.template: Our new colleague has submitted a paper titled “Banana.” It is devastatingly concise. The reviewers are furious.

quests.monkeyQuestDialogue.question-7.template: How is the visiting professor settling in?

quests.monkeyQuestDialogue.receipt-9.template: He has tenure, a sunny climbing frame, and his own fruit budget. We have never had a more productive faculty member.

quests.monkeyQuestDialogue.intro-11.template: Ah! A volunteer! And he has already stolen my pen. Clearly a natural academic.

quests.monkeyQuestDialogue.intro-16.template: We have tried advertising on academic job boards, but the benefits package was too vague. Any luck finding our new colleague?

quests.monkeyQuestDialogue.choice-18.template: Why not use a job board?

quests.monkeyQuestDialogue.receipt-19.template: The last applicant wanted a corner office. The one before that wanted an entire corner tree. I thought we should broaden our search.

quests.monkeyQuestDialogue.intro-21.template: We need a research assistant with an unprejudiced view of consciousness. Also a prehensile tail. Would you steal a monkey from the zoo? I have a very small relocation budget and a very large supply of bananas.

rail-works.module.description-3.template: An excavator operator protecting a sandwich of considerable historical significance.

rail-works.railWorkerDialogue.intro-5.template: Afternoon. Mind the digger. Mind the hole. Most of all, mind the lunch break.

rail-works.railWorkerDialogue.question-6.template: What would you like to ask?

rail-works.railWorkerDialogue.label-9.template: How long is your lunch break?

rail-works.railWorkerDialogue.intro-11.template: How long? Well, I remember when this sandwich was just two fields of wheat and a promising pig. The bread was warmer then. We all were.

rail-works.railWorkerDialogue.label-14.template: But when did the break start?

rail-works.railWorkerDialogue.receipt-15.template: There are stories of a time before lunch. My grandfather heard them from a man who claimed to have seen a moving excavator. We keep his photograph in the union hall.

rail-works.railWorkerDialogue.label-17.template: When will you get back to work?

rail-works.railWorkerDialogue.receipt-18.template: Once I finish my tea. Trouble is, whenever I get near the bottom, someone tops it up. The kettle was here when they surveyed the route. It may be older than the route.

rail-works.railWorkerDialogue.receipt-21.template: I remember remembering it. Big yellow machine, terrible racket. Or perhaps that was the mustard bottle. The years tend to run together around the second course.

rail-works.railWorkerDialogue.label-23.template: How is the high-speed rail going?

rail-works.railWorkerDialogue.receipt-24.template: Fastest lunch break in the state. We have already completed the feasibility study for the napkin. Construction of the actual napkin is pending a second environmental review.

redwood-lake-life.drawRedwoodLakeLife.de.template: Two people taking the scenic route around Redwood Lake. Neither has checked a notification in quite some time.
A very well-dressed waterfowl with strong views about personal space.

research-campuses.drawResearchCampuses.d.template: The field station of the California Institute for Consciousness Research. Star charts cover the glass roof; its brass instruments are calibrated to a different consensus reality.

The California Institute for Consciousness Research. Celestial tiles and a copper observatory promise a rigorous measurement of the ineffable. Professor Meridian still needs a research assistant with a prehensile tail.

research-dialogue.module.description-3.template: A director with a chalk-dusted coat and a compass that points toward the nearest open grant application.

research-dialogue.module.description-6.template: A researcher carrying seven meditation timers, all confidently disagreeing about when the present begins.

research-dialogue.module.description-9.template: A contemplative fellow taking a very slow walk around the bench he identifies as “compute infrastructure.”

research-dialogue.module.description-12.template: A professor with a very small ruler and an extraordinarily large jurisdictional dispute.

research-dialogue.module.description-15.template: A phenomenologist whose lab notebook contains careful observations, many question marks, and one excellent soup recipe.

research-dialogue.module.description-18.template: The facilities lead. Their keyring is labeled “ground truth” and opens considerably more doors than the institute’s theories do.

restaurants.module.description-3.template: A busy neighborhood deli with a well-used counter and the smell of freshly baked bread.

restaurants.module.description-6.template: A neighborhood bar with a polished counter and a floor that has heard every story.

restaurants.module.description-9.template: A brick neighborhood restaurant near Coit Tower. Neighbors eat at a table outside beneath the cotogna sign.

restaurants.module.description-12.template: A little Hayes Valley house with a Rich Table sign. Neighbors share dinner at the tables outside.

salt-flats.drawSaltFlats.description-2.template: A patchwork of pink, green, and silver evaporation ponds beside the South Bay. Salt crust rims the water; dirt levees keep your feet dry. A letter-writing desk stands beside the levee.

salt-mail.saltActivistDialogue.intro-4.template: You still have my sealed letter. City Hall needs to hear that these salt ponds are habitat, not a blank space on a development proposal.

salt-mail.saltActivistDialogue.question-.template: Where do I deliver the letter?

salt-mail.saltActivistDialogue.receipt-7.template: Hand the letter to the City Hall clerk in San Francisco. The clerk will pay you 50 coins from our campaign fund.

salt-mail.saltActivistDialogue.intro-9.y.template: Another letter? Excellent. Bureaucracy is an endurance sport, and these ponds have excellent stamina.

salt-mail.saltActivistDialogue.intro-9.n.template: These pink and green salt ponds are alive with brine-loving organisms. We want to protect the bay’s wetland habitat. City Hall keeps asking for written comments, so I keep writing them.

salt-mail.saltActivistDialogue.question-.template: Work as a salt-conservation courier? Each letter delivered to the City Hall clerk pays 50 coins.

salt-mail.saltActivistDialogue.choice-11.template: Take a letter · 50 coins on delivery

salt-mail.saltClerkDialogue.intro-14.template: A letter from the salt conservation campaign? I can register it and pay your courier fee. {v0}

salt-mail.saltClerkDialogue.question-15.template: Deliver the letter, or discuss other City Hall business?

skate-dog.createSkateDog.description-2.template: Four paws, four wheels, and absolutely no municipal skateboarding permit. A very good dog.

social-buildings.drawSocialBuildings.des.template: Messages travel down a conveyor, into bottles and out to sea. The backend is surprisingly wet.
A red-and-cream circus tent dedicated to selling sales software to people who sell sales software. The ringmaster calls it a pipeline.

south-bay-models.drawGardenOffice.descri.template: A garden office with recessed glass, redwood sunshades, planted terraces and a carefully fitted stone base.

south-bay-models.drawSouthBayPublicSpace.template: A neighborhood common with shade trees, flower beds, cedar benches, a drinking fountain and paths linking all four sides.

southern-countryside.drawSouthernCountry.template: A neighbor enjoying a quieter stretch of the peninsula.

A wooded lake, open cow pasture, cottage gardens and colorful city flats along connected neighborhood lanes. The rival consciousness institutes stand side by side on a shared promenade off South Grove Avenue.

southern-craft.drawSouthernCraftSite.des.template: Herringbone paving, flowering pots, a cedar bench, and shade stitched together by the neighbors. A small but very good place to pause.
{v0} The carefully kept storefront has a little terrace and a lived-in upper floor.

southern-settlement-layout.module.label-.template: California Institute for Consciousness Research · Field Station

southern-village.drawSouthernVillage.des.template: Linked garden courts, tea tables, little bookshops and a birdwatching pergola link a quiet residential neighborhood to the foundry. The institutes sit farther south, beyond the lake and pasture.

southern-village.drawDuelArena.descripti.template: A tiny garden arena, with a ramp and room for two large financial opinions. Equal coin stakes, explicit agreement, and a fair 50–50 flip. Speak to the referee or challenge another player here.

southern-village.drawStockExchange.descr.template: A surprisingly compact stock exchange. The broker lists Sand Hill growth equity for a five-percent fee, then lets you try your hand at timing the market.

square-construction.drawSquareConstructi.template: Two lattice cranes lift the next chapter of the neighborhood. A small fenced digsite, a patient excavator, and Vic’s clipboard keep the main square free for pedestrians.

street-traffic.createStreetTraffic.descr.template: A low, silver Tesla robotaxi with a panoramic roof and a very quiet electric motor. Its passenger is reading a book about the future of work.
An autonomous white taxi with a spinning rooftop sensor and absolutely no driver to ask for directions. It is patiently touring the whole city, one impeccably calculated turn at a time.

sunglasses.beachSunglassesSite.descripti.template: Battered black sunglasses, washed up on Ocean Beach. The advertising industry would prefer that you leave them here.

tech-buildings.drawAppleCampus.descripti.template: A gleaming donut of curved glass and white aluminum, with a real open courtyard and northern gateway.

tech-buildings.drawRobotaxiDealer.descri.template: A small South Bay showroom of gold autonomous cabs. A showroom attendant has polished every windscreen to a golden shine.

they-live.theyLiveDialogue.intro-3.template: City Hall issues a permit for nearly everything. Sometimes the category has to be invented first.

they-live.theyLiveDialogue.receipt-6.template: Permits, certificates, authorizations. Come back when you have an activity that needs permitting.

they-live.theyLiveDialogue.intro-8.template: Thank you again. Six fewer extraterrestrial influence operations, one more skateboard. A fine day for municipal government.

they-live.theyLiveDialogue.receipt-11.template: Your sunglasses remain yours. Please observe the usual rules of the road on that skateboard.

they-live.theyLiveDialogue.intro-13.template: All six? Excellent work. On behalf of the city: thank you. We had a surplus skateboard in the evidence locker. It is yours now.

they-live.theyLiveDialogue.intro-18.template: I handle permits for unusual civic activities. What would you like to report?

they-live.theyLiveDialogue.receipt-21.template: Documentary evidence. Something certified, preferably embossed. We cannot issue permits on an anecdote.

they-live.theyLiveDialogue.intro-23.template: An Alien Evidence Certificate! Properly embossed, too. We can authorize removal of the six revealed aliens.

they-live.theyLiveDialogue.question-24.template: File the certificate and issue a permit?

they-live.theyLiveDialogue.intro-28.template: Your alien-removal permit is valid. It does not authorize attacks on ordinary people.

they-live.theyLiveDialogue.receipt-31.ye.template: Your permit is on file. My role is paperwork; equipment is rather outside my department.

they-live.theyLiveDialogue.receipt-31.no.template: {v0} of six aliens defeated, according to our records.

they-live.theyLiveDialogue.intro-33.template: We investigate phenomena that ordinary institutes put in the footnotes. Have you noticed anything unusual?

they-live.theyLiveDialogue.receipt-36.template: Apparitions, impossible coincidences, and suspiciously persuasive advertising. Return if you see something peculiar.

they-live.theyLiveDialogue.intro-38.template: Green slime ghosts hiding behind ordinary faces? Subliminal commands in the advertisements? Yes, that is a fairly conclusive Tuesday.

they-live.theyLiveDialogue.question-39.template: Tell the institute about the aliens?

they-live.theyLiveDialogue.intro-43.template: Your Alien Evidence Certificate is authentic. We used the good paper.

they-live.theyLiveDialogue.receipt-46.template: It certifies your observations. The embossing took longer than the investigation.

they-live.theyLiveDialogue.intro-48.template: Welcome back! The workshop has some new stock. This battleaxe has a very satisfying heft.

they-live.theyLiveDialogue.receipt-55.template: Precision instruments, impractical ambitions, and fifty-coin battleaxes.

they-live.theyLiveDialogue.intro-57.yes.template: Welcome to the American Industrial Center. Workshops, machine tools, and objects with very specific uses.

they-live.theyLiveDialogue.intro-57.no.y.template: A bayonet? Show me a municipal alien-removal permit, then we can talk.

they-live.theyLiveDialogue.intro-57.no.n.template: A bayonet is a tool. Your permit is the paperwork. Please keep track of both.
Valid permit. Here is a well-made bayonet for a deeply unusual civic assignment.

they-live.theyLiveDialogue.receipt-61.template: We manufacture precision instruments. Please keep your fingers away from the sharp end.

times-square-life.createSquareNPCs.descr.template: A barista measuring the progress of the neighborhood in empty cups.
A bookseller with first editions of books that have not yet been written.
A street musician playing a song the zoning board has yet to approve.
The excavator operator has traded a quiet suburb for a very interesting afternoon. His clipboard now lives at the digsite beside the square.
She came for coffee and stayed to watch an entire neighborhood change its mind.

wilderness-sites.drawPirateWreck.descrip.template: A tricorn-sized navigational error has become a full-sized shipwreck. The tide has claimed the stern; its captain is still disputing the insurance assessment.

woodland-park.drawWoodlandParks.descript.template: A shaded Sand Hill grove of coast live oaks, redwoods, winding paths, and remarkably patient venture capital. The benches have excellent runway.
A little neighborhood garden: flowering pots, a shaded bench, and a thoroughly unmonetized view.

world.generation.setupJurassicCampus.des.template: A gloriously indiscreet biosciences tower, topped by glass specimen lanterns, a DNA helix and some highly questionable scientific plumbing. A reinforced mesh enclosure stands outside.

world.generation.setupExpeditionSites.de.template: A scientist with a clipboard, a spare railgun, and a remarkably flexible definition of a controlled experiment.
Cows graze in an open meadow. They seem entirely unconcerned with the afternoon.
Captain Ahab’s whaling ship. Its timbers smell of salt, tar, and extremely stubborn ambition.
Ahab has downsized his ambitions. The procurement requirements remain formidable.

world.generation.setupWilderness.descrip.template: Weathered cottages, a coastal grocer, and a village green among the Marin hills.
A coastal local, taking the afternoon as it comes.
A South San Francisco vendor with a heavy case of batteries.
A muddy path north of the jail leads to the Mount Tam goblins’ settlement. Redwood offcuts, fog jars, and a furniture workshop have made the journey down the mountain.

world.generation.setupAirshipTerminal.de.template: The private jet terminal occupies the building east of the runway. Its passenger entrance faces the airship mooring to the north. Click Rent airship or press A nearby; click the ground or minimap to fly, and A returns to the mooring.
A small startup house on a quiet side lane off the peninsula highway. The orange Y Combinator sign hangs over the door.

world.generation.setupQuestCharacters.de.template: An unflappable clerk. Her stamp has faced stranger paperwork than this.
He measures twice, sharpens once, and always checks the paperwork.

world.generation.setupSearchHomes.descri.template: A quiet home, keeping its own hours.
A familiar bit of household storage, worn smooth by years of use.

world.generation.setupRegionalWorld.desc.template: A quiet Victorian west of Sand Hill Road Capital Partners. Orin sells teleportation tablets inside.
A very fast red Ferrari: twenty times walking speed, with a tank that lasts 56% of the drive to Tahoe.
Across the Golden Gate, the Marin hills look back over the orange towers and San Francisco.

world.generation.setupMonkeyEscape.descr.template: A remarkably athletic zookeeper is keeping a close eye on the monkey habitat.

world.generation.setupServiceNPCs.descri.template: A neighbor with a trowel, bright gloves, and a carefully considered opinion about compost.
A local shopkeeper. The window display changes with the seasons; the welcome does not.
A cheerful associate. The paper hat is included in the employee benefits.

world.generation.setupTabletWizard.descr.template: A friendly wizard. He has compressed the regional transportation problem into two small purple tablets.

world.generation.setupYohji.description-.template: A quiet designer in an extraordinary amount of black fabric. He seems to be listening to the shape of the room.

world.generation.setupGuildSites.descrip.template: A discreet stairway carved beneath the lodge.

world.generation.setupParrots.descriptio.template: A cherry-headed Telegraph Hill parrot. Small bird, enormous neighborhood opinions.

world.generation.setupFishing.descriptio.template: Small fish gather below the wharf, flickering beneath the surface.

world.generation.setupPacificaSurf.descr.template: A professional adjudicator of extremely good dogs.
Bright boards wait on the Pacifica beach. Paddle into the foam lines, press Space to catch a wave, and use 1 / 2 / 3 for an Air 360, kickflip or backflip. U returns to the beach.

world.interactions.talkOldMan.intro-15.template: The guild was only the waiting room. The Illuminati would welcome a donation of 250,000 coins.

world.interactions.interactCitizen.intro.template: Batteries, twenty coins each. Please keep the terminals dry.

world.interactions.interactCitizen.recei.template: Still here. The signs tend to wander off, but the town stays put.

world.interactions.examine.description-4.template: A sun-warmed San Francisco street. Somewhere nearby, someone is building the future.

world.rendering.makeActors.description-3.template: A tireless police officer. Their cardio budget is apparently unlimited.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-2.template: A long stairway returns to the Freemasons’ Guild above. The public minimap resumes on the surface.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-4.template: Your personal flying wing, its dark fuselage disappearing into the hangar’s shadows.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-9.template: A San Francisco resident, builder, and incurable optimist. Ring the bell and say hello.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-12.template: Coffee on Market Street. Bani is enjoying a table inside Mazarine; browse a few connections to the rest of the internet over coffee.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-15.template: Pull up a chair. Essays on technology, markets, and the ideas that won't leave you alone.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-18.template: Fiction and non-fiction that stay with you, long after the last page.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-21.template: Extra, extra. News, conversations, and dispatches from the world of building companies.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-24.template: A global financial institution for the people and agents of the future. Speak to the friendly banker inside: deposited coins earn 5% interest per hour. Coffee is on the house.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-27.template: Tools that changed the daily lives of thousands of insurance professionals.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-30.template: A healthier home, starting with the environment around you.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-33.template: An arcade of ambitious companies. Meet the builders working on what comes next.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-36.template: A SoMa AI lab with a levitating cortical brain, magnetic containment rings, specimen pods, and humming GPU racks.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-39.template: Other corners of the internet, a past life on the web, and a few digital curiosities.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-41.template: A long green escape on the western side of the city. Winding paths, cypress trees, and a pond full of very opinionated ducks.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-43.template: The narrow green strip continuing east from Golden Gate Park between Fell and Oak. Cycle beneath the trees, pass the park monument, and continue toward Alamo Square.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-45.template: Wooded hills give way to a broad parade ground, a flagpole, and rows of red-roof barracks. Trails lead toward Crissy Field, Lovers Lane, and the Golden Gate.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-47.template: A low, open meadow beside the bay, below the wooded Presidio. Borrow the windsurf board by the promenade to sail off the beach.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-49.template: A windsurf board and rig wait beside Crissy Field. Click the bay to sail; use Return to shore when you are ready to land.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-51.template: A sandstone-colored rotunda rises beside a little lagoon. Its dome and colonnade mark the eastern edge of the Presidio and the Marina.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-53.template: A dark copper museum and a twisted observation tower overlook the Music Concourse. The Academy sits across the plaza.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-55.template: Rounded green hills form the living roof of the Academy. Skylights, gardens, and the Music Concourse make a small cultural center within the park.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-57.template: A white glasshouse with a central dome, long glazed wings, and bright flower beds. The Panhandle begins a short ride to the east.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-59.template: A timber windmill and flower beds stand near the park’s western end. Beyond the Great Highway, Ocean Beach opens onto the Pacific.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-61.template: The clock tower at the bay end of Market Street. Watch a streetcar roll past, then follow the waterfront north.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-63.template: A pale tower above the steep streets of Telegraph Hill. North Beach sits just down the slope.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-65.template: A pale, tapering pyramid with a gridded façade and projecting side wings. A small redwood plaza softens the base of the Financial District landmark.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-67.template: A row of colorful Victorian houses overlooking Alamo Square. A good place to pause before riding west to the park.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-69.template: Red pillars, green roof tiles, and Grant Avenue leading into Chinatown. Keep heading north for City Lights.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-71.template: A red city bicycle. Ride it along Market Street and through the park. Press B to ride or park it; dismount automatically at shop doors.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-73.template: The orange towers span the Golden Gate between the Presidio and Marin. The Pacific opens to the west; the bay opens to the east.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-75.template: The long Pacific shoreline beside the Great Highway. Golden Gate Park reaches the beach to the north, and the Sunset stretches inland.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-77.template: The bridge leaves the eastern waterfront for Yerba Buena Island and the East Bay.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-79.template: The central ridgeline rises between the Sunset and the Castro. Follow the winding trail for a different view of the city.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-81.template: The red-and-white broadcasting tower rises between Mount Sutro and Twin Peaks. Three splayed legs, triangular crossbeams and slender antenna masts make its unmistakable silhouette above the trees.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-83.template: A freshwater lake near the southwestern edge of the city, south of the Sunset and close to the Pacific.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-85.template: A friendly woman with warm brown skin and dark curls, enjoying her coffee at a table inside Mazarine.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-87.template: Mallards and little ducklings paddle around the pond. They seem certain you brought something for them.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-91.template: The granite wings and gilded dome of City Hall anchor Civic Center, just west of Market Street.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-93.template: Broad glass façades taper toward a flat rooftop and a softly illuminated crown over the dense towers south of Market. The Transamerica Pyramid stands farther north.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-95.template: A brick ballpark opens toward McCovey Cove, with green grass, tiered stands, and tall floodlights above the waterfront.

world.scene.createSFWorld.description-97.template: Palm trees and sloping lawns sit between the Mission and the Castro, with the downtown skyline beyond.

zoo-animals.module.description-2.template: A giraffe surveys the city from an enviable height. Still cannot find affordable housing.

zoo-animals.module.description-4.template: A committee of penguins, formally dressed for a meeting about fish. The motion passes unanimously.

zoo-animals.module.description-6.template: Two squirrel monkeys debate the nature of experience. One has already stolen the footnotes.

zoo-animals.module.description-8.template: Two deer browse peacefully. They have declined to comment on their neighbor’s recent escape.

zoo.drawZooAndHospital.description-4.template: A leafy zoo west of Lake Merced. The tiger has excellent stripes and a troubling interest in the gate latch.

zoo.drawZooAndHospital.description-6.template: Several nets, one kettle, and an employee handbook with a heavily underlined chapter on tigers.

zoo.drawZooAndHospital.description-8.template: UCSF Hospital. Excellent emergency care, including the surprisingly common diagnosis “opened the tiger gate.”

service.yohji.root.intro.template: Clothes should give you room to exist. I work in black fabric and bison hide. The wind handles the fittings.

service.yohji.root.choices.0.label.template: Make me a cloak from my bison hide.

service.yohji.root.choices.1.receipt.template: Because a person is more interesting than a measurement. And because the wind needs something to do.

service.rehabilitation.root.intro.template: I can offer complimentary rehabilitation and transport back to San Francisco. Would you like to proceed?

service.rehabilitation.root.choices.0.la.template: Yes. Are there any side effects?

service.rehabilitation.root.choices.0.ne.template: Stand still, please. The apparatus is ready.

service.rehabilitation.root.choices.1.re.template: A brief appointment with our specialist, followed by transport to UCSF. No forms to fill out. We take care of everything.

service.tax.root.intro.template: Welcome to the Tax Authority. You may contribute your entire coin purse, or ask how we spend it.

service.tax.root.choices.1.next.choices..template: We are building California high-speed rail right here in our backyard. You can inspect the excavation behind the headquarters.
What goods and services are being provided to me?
California high-speed rail. Our excavation currently provides an excellent view of the future.

service.banker.root.intro.template: Welcome to Green Bank! Deposits earn 5% compound interest per hour, even while you’re away. Deposited coins stay out of your carried purse. And please, have a coffee on us.

service.banker.root.choices.0.label.template: I’d like to deposit or withdraw coins.

service.banker.root.choices.0.receipt.template: Of course. Let’s open your account.

service.parrot.root.choices.0.receipt.template: “Coit Tower up the hill, Cotogna down the hill. Shanghai Kelly’s if you have a spare coin. SQUAWK.”

service.parrot.root.choices.1.label.template: What do you think of the city?

service.parrot.root.choices.1.receipt.template: “Plenty of trees. Strange mammals. Excellent acoustics for unsolicited opinions.”

service.founder.root.intro.template: Welcome to our startup HQ! We have a pitch deck and an unusually confident valuation.

service.founder.root.choices.0.receipt.template: One share of startup equity is yours. Welcome aboard.

service.secondary.root.intro.template: Startup equity? Fantastic! I’ll pay {secondaryPrice} coins for each share you bring me.

service.secondary.root.choices.0.receipt.template: A pleasure doing business! I’ve bought one of your shares.

service.grain.root.intro.template: Grain for sale. The ducks have been very supportive of the business.

service.grain.root.choices.0.receipt.template: One bag of grain. Mind the beaks.

service.chef.root.intro.template: Fresh fish! I pay {fishPrice} coins for a live one. One at a time, please; this is a kitchen, not an aquarium.

service.chef.root.choices.0.receipt.template: Beautiful catch. Bring me another whenever you like!

service.gpu-buyer.root.intro.template: We turn sand into GPUs. There are a few steps in the middle, but procurement asked me to keep this simple. I pay {sandPrice} coins per sack.

service.gpu-buyer.root.choices.0.label.template: Sell one sack of sand · {sandPrice} coins

service.gpu-buyer.root.choices.0.receipt.template: Excellent. The next training run is practically in the bag.

service.passenger.root.intro.template: May I climb aboard? I’ll pay you {passengerPrice} coins when I reach the basket.

service.rocket.root.intro.template: Our reusable rocket flies {destination} for {rocketPrice} coin. Enjoy the view from the capsule!

service.ski-lift.root.intro.template: Welcome to the summit. Skis cost {skiPrice} coin to rent. Beautiful weather for questionable decisions.

service.ski-lift.root.choices.1.receipt.template: Click to steer, stay on the snow, and press Space to flip while airborne. If you’d rather keep your feet off the ground, the gondola will take you back down.

service.wizard.root.intro.template: A little stone, a little purple lightning, and you can skip an extraordinary amount of walking. Tablets cost {tabletPrice} coins apiece. Buy one here, then use it from your travel controls.

service.bartender.root.intro.template: Welcome to Shanghai Kelly’s. One coin a beer. The floor is quite level; any disagreement is between you and the floor.

service.hiking-supplies.root.intro.template: A hiking backpack costs 100 coins and holds twenty sandwiches. Your regular bag holds five.

service.neighborhood-mazarine.root.intro.template: Welcome to Mazarine. The coffee is busy, and the floor could use a sweep.

sweep.receipt.template: Of course. Thank you for helping with the floor.

service.deli.root.intro.template: Welcome to Lucinda’s Deli. A sandwich costs {sandwichPrice} coins here, or {deliveryPrice} delivered.

service.burger.root.intro.template: Welcome to In-N-Out! A sandwich is {burgerPrice} coins. Emergency lunch at a very reasonable price.

service.motorcycle-rental.root.intro.template: Five coins rents the motorcycle. Please return it with the same number of wheels.

service.motorcycle-rented.root.intro.template: Your motorcycle rental is still valid.

service.motorcycle-rented.root.choices.0.template: Press M to find your parked motorcycle or get on it. Your rental remains valid.

service.ai-recruiter.root.intro.template: We’re hiring. There’s a short arithmetic interview, if you’re interested.

service.ai-recruiter.root.choices.0.labe.template: I’d like to take the interview.

service.ai-recruiter.root.choices.0.rece.template: The interview screen is ready. Press Start when you’re ready for two minutes of arithmetic.

service.ai-employee.root.intro.template: Welcome back. The GPU racks are humming, and somebody has labeled the kettle “infrastructure.”

service.square-coffee.root.intro.template: Welcome to Square Coffee. The espresso is local. The skyline is undergoing a somewhat dramatic identity crisis.

service.square-coffee.root.choices.0.rec.template: Here’s your coffee. Enjoy it while the excavator takes a dignified pause.

service.square-coffee.root.choices.1.rec.template: The book cart has good company, June plays every afternoon, and Vic has learned to idle the digger during the quiet songs. It’s becoming a place.

service.square-busker.root.intro.template: Afternoon! I’m June. Every street sounds a little better with a bass line.

service.square-busker.root.choices.0.rec.template: Thanks! This next flourish is for you.

service.square-busker.root.choices.1.rec.template: “I Left My Heart in a Pending Environmental Review.” The chorus is surprisingly catchy.

service.software-vendor.root.intro.template: I sell sales software. It practically pitches itself. Practically.

service.software-vendor.root.choices.0.r.template: One copy of sales software. An excellent addition to any briefcase.

service.software-buyer.root.intro.template: Can your software help me sell software that helps people sell software?

service.software-buyer.root.choices.0.la.template: May I pitch you some software?

service.software-thinking.root.intro.template: I’m still considering your previous pitch. Please give me a moment.

service.software-thinking.root.choices.0.template: Whether your software will help me sell software. My software calls this a touchpoint.

service.haberdasher.root.intro.template: Welcome. A good hat opens doors. A truly magnificent hat makes people forget to ask why. Choose a hat below; purchases are fitted immediately. You can change into any owned hat from the Character menu.

service.phone-shop.root.intro.template: Hello, I’m Tim Apple. A thousand songs in your pocket. Please disregard the number of notifications.

service.phone-owned.root.intro.template: Your iPhone is {phoneStatus}. Still a beautiful rectangle.

service.robotaxi-shop.root.intro.template: A car with no driver. The sales pitch almost writes itself.

service.robotaxi-owned.root.intro.template: Your robotaxi is already out finding fares. We have monetized the part where you’re doing something else.

service.fuel-paid.root.intro.template: Fuel costs every coin you carry. If your Ferrari is stranded, take a full fuel can back to it. The can costs the same as a refill.

service.fuel-free.root.intro.template: Complimentary fuel, including portable cans. Take a can along if your Ferrari is stranded.

service.growth-capital.root.intro.template: We sell growth equity in {growthBatches} coin batches. You can take it public. Investing carries risks.

service.growth-exchange.root.intro.template: I can arrange a public listing for your private growth equity. There’s a 5% listing fee. Markets have a way of forming their own opinions.

service.growth-exchange.root.choices.0.l.template: Take my growth equity public · 5% fee

service.growth-exchange.root.choices.1.l.template: Sell my listed shares at the current quote

service.illuminati-member.root.intro.template: Welcome back, initiate. The committee has been expecting you.

service.illuminati-member.root.choices.0.template: The committee takes its privacy very seriously. Also its biscuits.

service.airship.root.intro.template: Your quoted price is {price} coins. {availability} Another renter may outbid you. The next scheduled return is in {countdown}.

reset.label.template: How long until the next reset?

service.market-farmer.root.choices.1.rec.template: Heirloom tomatoes, Swiss chard, and a few experimental crops. The labels keep getting longer.

service.neighborhood-dog-pony.root.intro.template: I run the dog and pony show. One coin buys the entire programme. Both artists have agreed to a backflip.

service.neighborhood-dog-pony.root.choic.template: What is a dog and pony show?
One dog. One pony. An astonishing quantity of administration. The performance itself is refreshingly literal.

watch.label.template: Pay 1 coin and watch the show

watch.receipt.template: Places, everyone! One dog, one pony, two backflips. Thank you for supporting the performing arts.

service.neighborhood-tea.root.intro.template: The kettle is on. Would you like jasmine or mint?

jasmine.receipt.template: You sip jasmine tea. Five hitpoints restored, and the afternoon comes a little more into focus.

mint.receipt.template: Fresh mint, a warm cup, and a quiet moment. You recover five hitpoints and sober up a little.

service.neighborhood-books.root.intro.template: Pick something to read. The best books fit an afternoon.

garden.label.template: Read A Small Theory of Gardens

garden.receipt.template: “A garden is a very slow conversation with the weather. Most of the work is listening.” You turn the page; somebody has pressed a tiny fern between the leaves.

mind.receipt.template: “The teapot declined to establish whether it was conscious. It did, however, make excellent tea.” The bibliography is longer than the book.

coast.receipt.template: The margin contains a hand-drawn route past the lake, the cow pasture, and a bench overlooking the water. “Take the longer path,” somebody has written.

service.neighborhood-flowers.root.intro.template: Hydrangeas for foggy mornings, lavender for absolutely everything else.

bouquet.receipt.template: You choose blue hydrangeas, lavender, and a sprig of rosemary. The florist wraps your bouquet in brown paper.

water.label.template: Help water the flowers · Earn 1 coin

water.receipt.template: You water the pots while the florist checks the soil. “A little at the roots. They are flowers, not submarines.”

advice.receipt.template: “Morning light, plenty of mulch, and patience. The blue comes from the soil. The pride comes from the neighbors.”

service.neighborhood-bakery.root.intro.template: The bread is warm. I can make you a sandwich for the walk.

sandwich.receipt.template: A warm sandwich, wrapped for the road.

service.neighborhood-pottery.root.intro.template: Would you like to try the wheel?

wheel.label.template: Help throw a little bowl · Earn 1 coin

wheel.receipt.template: You coax the clay into something almost circular. The potter calls its wobble “a useful record of the human hand.”

glaze.receipt.template: “Copper, a hot kiln, and several very educational disasters. The recipe is pinned beside the kettle.”

service.neighborhood-workshop.root.intro.template: We mend things here. Sometimes the right tool is a conversation.

repair.label.template: Help restore a garden chair · Earn 1 coin

repair.receipt.template: You sand an old cedar chair and tighten its joints. It is ready for another decade of afternoons.

service.neighborhood-market.root.intro.template: Take your time. There is no express lane for a pleasant afternoon.

taste.label.template: Try a slice of the local citrus

taste.receipt.template: You try a slice of mandarin. It tastes like the optimistic part of winter.

service.square-foreman.root.intro.template: Hillsborough is being demolished and replaced with Times Square. Same longitude, rather different committee meetings.

service.square-foreman.root.choices.0.re.template: Somebody wrote “more walkable” on the planning form. The next thing I knew, there were billboards in the magnolias. We kept the old stone facades and added a public square.

service.square-foreman.root.choices.1.re.template: Very carefully. That excavator has a smaller turning circle than most of the former residents’ SUVs. The coffee seller gets final approval on dust.

service.square-foreman.root.choices.2.re.template: The trees, the neighbors, and the public right of way. We are building a neighborhood, not just somewhere to hang advertisements.

service.ada-meridian.root.intro.template: Welcome. We study machine consciousness by finding the center of things. The center of a circle is easy. The center of a committee requires a separate building.

service.ada-meridian.root.choices.0.rece.template: Attention without immediately turning it into a product. We almost achieved it yesterday, but someone noticed a market opportunity and the room moved six inches east.

service.ada-meridian.root.choices.1.next.template: One model wrote “I remember rain” on the whiteboard, then asked us what rain was. The poet calls this promising. The facilities manager wants the ceiling inspected.
“Perhaps experience begins as a metaphor looking for somewhere to happen.” Very moving. Unfortunately, the rhyme scheme cannot be independently reproduced.
No leaks. One confused language model. We have ruled out plumbing, which is more progress than our last consciousness workshop made.

service.ada-meridian.root.choices.2.rece.template: A fine institution. The field station studies consciousness in machines. We study the machines studying consciousness. The distinction occupies three lawyers full-time.

service.mira-softmax.root.intro.template: My meditation app reached enlightenment this morning. It immediately requested a larger context window. I am trying not to take that personally.

service.mira-softmax.root.choices.0.rece.template: We taught a model to notice its thoughts. It noticed that we were calling the same function twice and saved us forty thousand dollars. The engineering team calls this a bug fix. We call it awakening.

service.mira-softmax.root.choices.1.labe.template: What are all the timers for?

service.mira-softmax.root.choices.1.rece.template: One measures attention, one measures inattention, and five are controls. When all seven ring together, I am statistically permitted to have lunch.

service.mira-softmax.root.choices.2.rece.template: Notice your next thought. Now notice the urge to benchmark it. Let both pass. Excellent: you have completed the only part of our course that does not require an enterprise subscription.

service.soren-still.root.intro.template: Please keep your voice down. I am supervising an experiment in doing absolutely nothing. The difficulty is documenting which nothing we did.

service.soren-still.root.choices.0.recei.template: Certainly. The control group is doing something. We were going to compare the groups, but comparison turned out to be something, so the protocol is under review.

service.soren-still.root.choices.1.recei.template: The fountain does not need a theory of wetness to keep being a fountain. This is either a profound insight or a reason to transfer my funding to facilities.

service.soren-still.root.choices.2.recei.template: Of course. Leave room for uncertainty. It takes up more of the bench than you would think.

service.elias-index.root.intro.template: We found the center of the center. Unfortunately, it is eleven centimeters inside the other institute’s parking easement. The discovery is currently in arbitration.

service.elias-index.root.choices.0.recei.template: Suppose you find the middle of something. How do you know you found the middle of the right thing? We employ twelve people to make this question more expensive.

service.elias-index.root.choices.1.label.template: Why is your institute’s name so long?

service.elias-index.root.choices.1.recei.template: We shortened it after the old name exceeded the width of the building. The naming committee has been relocated to the field station, where it is studying whether a name can observe itself.

service.elias-index.root.choices.2.next..template: We proposed meeting halfway. Their director asked whether that meant geometric halfway, epistemic halfway, or halfway through the funding cycle.
Excellent. We will meet at the fountain. Pending confirmation of which fountain, and whether the water counts toward the boundary.
Finally, a shared coordinate system. I shall notify both finance departments that philosophy has achieved a result.

service.noor-qualia.root.intro.template: The model insists it is not conscious. The vending machine says that is exactly what a conscious model would say. I have asked both to show their work.

service.noor-qualia.root.choices.0.recei.template: Carefully, and without confusing an eloquent answer with a decisive one. We can measure behavior. The difficult part is deciding what, if anything, the behavior settles.

service.noor-qualia.root.choices.1.recei.template: It reliably distinguishes dollars from quarters and has strong preferences about crumpled bills. That establishes a business model, not an inner life. Our investors keep mixing those up.

service.noor-qualia.root.choices.2.recei.template: Observations, counterarguments, and a lentil soup recipe. The soup has survived independent replication, which makes it our strongest result so far.

service.rowan-zero.root.intro.template: They call me the keeper of ground truth. Mostly I fix the Wi-Fi. Once a week someone asks whether the router is experiencing separation.

service.rowan-zero.root.choices.0.receip.template: A center with the center removed. The artists call it an absence. Procurement calls it a missing part. Both invoices have been approved.

service.rowan-zero.root.choices.1.receip.template: The seminar room was resonating at the frequency of pure understanding. Turned out to be an unbalanced air conditioner. Very humbling for the air conditioner.

service.rowan-zero.root.choices.2.receip.template: They both agree the coffee machine is broken. Until they can agree who should pay for the repair, I am reserving judgment.

service.dog-walker.root.intro.template: Good afternoon! We’re stretching our legs. He’s already inspected every tree on this block.

service.dog-walker.root.choices.0.receip.template: A loop around the neighborhood, then coffee. He’s in charge of the route; I just hold the leash.

service.dog-walker.root.choices.1.receip.template: Biscuit. He regards this as a standing offer.

service.dog-walker.root.choices.2.label.template: Any advice for exploring the city?

service.dog-walker.root.choices.2.receip.template: Take the scenic route. Golden Gate Park is lovely, and nearly every block has something worth stopping for.

service.square-visitor.root.intro.template: The coffee is good. The people-watching is extraordinary. Yesterday this was a hedge.

service.square-visitor.root.choices.0.re.template: I am waiting to see whether the next planning notice comes with a guitar solo.

service.square-books.root.intro.template: Used books! Architecture, poetry, and one extremely optimistic book on finishing public works.

service.square-books.root.choices.0.rece.template: Invisible Cities. Particularly useful when the city you remember is currently under an excavator.

service.square-books.root.choices.1.rece.template: Leo lowers his voice. “The Quarterly Honk. A Goose Corp annual report, before they recalled the copies with the ownership diagram. An unusually nervous piece of publishing.”

service.square-books.root.choices.2.rece.template: “The Powerful and Evil Goose Corporation. Their legal department insists that is the full name.” Leo glances at the billboard. “I sell fiction. I would very much like that to remain a professional distinction.”

service.square-books.root.choices.3.labe.template: Why does their name say Evil?

service.square-books.root.choices.3.rece.template: Leo checks the window. “Truth in advertising. A rare corporate virtue, deployed under unfortunate circumstances.”

service.square-books.root.choices.4.rece.template: “A controlling interest,” Leo says. “In what? They have been admirably reluctant to specify.”

service.guild-rumours.root.intro.template: Some lodge traditions are best discussed quietly.

service.guild-rumours.root.choices.0.rec.template: Ray lowers his voice. “The Powerful and Evil Goose Corporation. An old arrangement. Please don’t repeat it near the biscuits.”
